description: Доклад за състоянието на канализационните мрежи и пречиствателните станции за отпадъчни води и генерираната утайка и съответствието с изискванията на Директива 91/271/ЕИО (Доклад по чл. 15 от Директивата) is a dataset listed in Open Data Bulgaria, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by moew.government.bg. Report on the status of collecting systems and waste water treatment plants and generated sludge and compliance with the requirements of Directive 91/271/EEC (Report under Article 15 of the Directive). Coverage: BG. The portal shows the English title as "Report on the status of collecting systems and waste water treatment plants and generated sludge and compliance with the" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Агломерации, канализационни системи, пречистване, утайки, РМС 435/2020, околна среда. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-bulgaria.
